data.current_description:

inclusive `start`–`end` date window, oldest first. Either bound may
be omitted. A period's value is the most recent reading of it.
`start` after `end` returns `400`; an unknown series returns `404`.

Requires the `reference-series` entitlement family; requests without
it return `404` `not_found`.

Requires the `reference-series` entitlement family. Returns `400` if start date is after end date, and `404` if the series is unknown or outside your authorization.

data.current_summary: Get the correlation of two series
data.current_description:
Returns the Pearson correlation of two series' daily log changes over
the `window` days ending today (UTC). A change is counted on a date
when both series have a value on that date and on the day before, and
both values are positive; `overlap_days` is how many dates qualified.
`coefficient` is `null` below 30 overlapping days, or when either
series did not move over them.

Either operand may be a reference series or a custom index id such as
`h100-us`; the index's daily values are used. An index operand needs
your key to hold that index — otherwise `404` `not_found`, as on the
custom-index routes — and an unknown series or index is `404`.

Requires the `reference-series` entitlement family; requests without
it return `404` `not_found`.
data.summary_suggestion: Calculate Pearson correlation between two series
data.description_suggestion: Calculates the Pearson correlation coefficient of daily log changes between two series over a specified rolling window ending today (UTC). Accepts either reference series (power prices, token prices) or custom index identifiers (e.g., `h100-us`) as operands. Returns the correlation coefficient, overlap_days (count of dates where both series had positive values on consecutive days), and metadata. The coefficient is `null` if fewer than 30 overlapping days exist or if either series showed no movement. Requires authorization for any custom index operand and the `reference-series` entitlement family. Returns `404` for unknown series, unauthorized indices, or missing entitlements.

data.current_summary: Get commitment pricing by contract length
data.current_description:
Recent reserved, non-rolling deals for the selected GPU in us, global+us
and apac+us regions, over 120 UTC dates ending today. Requires BOTH the
selected index scope and private-txns family, included with Enterprise.
Supported IDs are a100-us, h100-us, h200-us, b200-us and b300-us.
Missing index_id follows the key's usual default-index rules. No
historical as-of override is accepted.

Exact stored term bounds form buckets. Midpoints divided by 30 define
months. Bucket means are GPU-weighted. The log-tenor fit minimizes
sum(sqrt(bucket GPUs) * (mean - a - b*ln(1+months))^2). It requires at
least three distinct midpoints and is defined only over observed support.
Twelve months means a 360-day commitment, not delivery twelve months
from today. A 365-day bucket remains distinct. This is neither a
forecast nor an executable quote; regions and contract quality vary.
Insufficient or invalid fits return observations with a null fit.
Fewer than ten deals sets sparse; it is not a confidence measure.
Responses, including errors, are private and no-store.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve negotiated GPU pricing curves by commitment term
data.description_suggestion: Returns historical negotiated GPU pricing organized by commitment term length for the specified GPU series. Data covers 120 recent UTC dates ending today across us, global+us, and apac+us regions. Supported GPU IDs: a100-us, h100-us, h200-us, b200-us, b300-us. Requires both the custom-index entitlement and private-txns family (Enterprise only). Returns bucket-aggregated pricing with GPU-weighted means and optional log-tenor curve fits. Fits require at least three distinct term midpoints; sparse data (fewer than ten deals) is flagged. This represents historical negotiated rates, not forecasts or executable quotes. Responses are private and not cached.
